transfer.source_custody: Prior source SHA family/spec checked before first source action; no new model training, curriculum or source recompilation; fresh seeds scan reachable parent, no claim inaccessible branches are scanned.
transfer.cold_start: Per role and family original-state new on first seed, source selected memory only between seeds within same family; no transfer of learned weight or cache from MG44.
transfer.original_observations: 7x7x3 first-person image, public heading, literal mission and own selected action/feedback only; never original private world inventory, pose, coordinates or source scripted task solutions.

comparison.primary: genuine original reward-positive and terminated episode count for each family and role; include exact matched own selected goal target public disappearance, original selected actions and task-family goal observation
comparison.policy_custody: call unmodified imported PublicSlotRelease and public_release_episode from exact MG44; original MG44 source code SHA fingerprint, no copied/recompiled/tuned candidate; unchanged MG44 disabled ablation exact source
comparison.control_set: all 16 previous unchanged original Farama and native/conventional roles, per-family source-equivalent actions; source-native computational resource parity not qualified
comparison.resource_accounting: record outer host wall-time and Python process CPU-time per episode and source action counts for all roles. This excludes native Go child CPU/RSS; label explicitly not full cost parity.
comparison.target_metrics: original public literal pickup mission matcher with exact front, original own action3 true disappearance and heading unchanged. Real original mission goal only reward positive terminated.
comparison.no_counterfactual: same seeds independently executed trajectories, no matched states or hidden-state causal inference
comparison.new_family_disclosure: two KeyCorridor variants are scaling not new causal family, ObstructedMaze is a distinct Farama maze family but not a wholly different simulator
comparison.known_scientific_limitation: Fresh untouched DEV identities and authentic sourced source world is not independently sealed scientific first-use or external independent witness.

conditions: at least one authentic source positive goal episode in ObstructedMaze distinct environment family
candidate positive original goals in at least two of three new transfer environments
candidate at least one actual source mission-target pickup effect
candidate total goals on transfer cohorts strictly exceeds every listed conventional control
source-only exact unmodified MG44 candidate attest + independent original source processes identical
